meta.prompt_source: 用户提供图表作文题（未标注年份出处）

band.rationale: 对照第五档描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务——包含所有内容要点（题面要求 describe 与 comments 均完成，图表三组数据 35%/45%/20% 全部准确覆盖）；语言自然流畅，语法错误极少（逐句核查未发现一处硬性语法或拼写错误）；有效地采用多种衔接手法（while、On the one hand/On the other hand、Therefore、but），文字连贯，层次清晰（描述—归因—评论三段递进）；格式和语域恰当贴切。不足在于词汇丰富度中等、高频套语偏多且论证展开较简，故取第五档下段分数。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more.

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Two factors may explain this pattern. On the one hand, many students are under heavy academic pressure, so they give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两条原因与两条建议各仅一句，无例子、无数据回扣，展开深度不足，扣 0.5。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Two factors may explain this pattern. …… On the other hand, some students are willing to help others, but they lack information about how to join suitable programs.

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, broaden their horizons and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: students in a university …… broaden their horizons
dimensions.deduction_reason: 整体搭配准确（give priority to、a sense of responsibility），但存在 in a university 这类轻微搭配合生硬处，且 broaden their horizons 等高频套语偏多，按第 5 节微降 0.5（未超 1 分上限）。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: In my view, volunteer activities deserve more attention.

consistency.adjustments: 维度分初评合计 5+2.5+2+2+1.5+1=14，直接落在第五档 13–15 区间内，无需回调。

sentence_edits.original: The chart above illustrates how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities each month.
sentence_edits.issue: 表示“在某所大学”更地道的介词是 at a university，in a university 略显生硬；因不算硬性规则违反，按“拿不准一律降级”原则记为 awkward，不单独扣分。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart above illustrates how often students at a university take part in volunteer activities each month.

sentence_edits.original: The chart above illustrates how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities each month.
sentence_edits.issue: how often 与 each month 语义有部分重叠，删去 each month 会更简洁，仅为润色参考。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart above illustrates how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: According to the survey, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 题面自述为 chart，写 the survey 属于合理推断、可以接受；若想更贴题、更稳妥，可改用 the statistics。
sentence_edits.revised: According to the statistics, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more.

sentence_edits.original: while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: one or two times 更自然的说法是 once or twice，three times or more 也常写作 three or more times；均为润色建议。
sentence_edits.revised: while 45 percent volunteer once or twice a month, and only 20 percent do so three or more times.

sentence_edits.original: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, broaden their horizons and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.
sentence_edits.issue: broaden their horizons 是高频套语，可换成更具体的收益描述让语言更有个人色彩；仅作润色参考。
sentence_edits.revised: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, communicate with people from different backgrounds and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.

improved_version:
The chart above illustrates how often students at a university take part in volunteer activities. According to the statistics, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent do so only once or twice a month, and merely 20 percent volunteer three or more times. Clearly, participation remains low for most students.

Two factors may explain this pattern. On the one hand, many students are under heavy academic pressure, so they give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury they cannot afford. On the other hand, some students are willing to help others, but they simply lack information about how to find suitable programs.

In my view, volunteer activities deserve far more attention. Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, communicate with people from different backgrounds and develop a stronger sense of responsibility. Therefore, the university should provide more opportunities and timely information, while students should learn to balance study with service to society.
top_problems: 论证展开偏薄：两条原因和两条建议各只有一句话，缺少例子或数据回扣，内容展开与评论维度未能拿满，也限制了档内分数上限。
词汇偏模板化：broaden their horizons、in my view、On the one hand/On the other hand 等高频套语密度较高，搭配准确但丰富度和具体性不足。
首段以罗列三组百分比为主，缺少一句总括性趋势概括（如“多数学生每月参与不足两次”），图表解读的深度还可再进一步。
practice_advice: 针对评论段做“一句观点 + 一句支撑”扩写训练：从任意范文中挑一个观点句，强制补写一句例子、数据回扣或后果说明，每次 10 分钟、连练 5 天，让每个论证从“点到为止”变成“有支撑”。
